items.html: Now, from these two corners, which are Metzpatz and Metzpatz, from there the thirteen corrections of the beard are drawn, which are the thirteen attributes of mercy, whose beginning is from "El Rahum" etc., as above. Therefore, before "El Rahum" etc., two Names, Hei Hei, are mentioned, for those two Names are the two Names Metzpatz and Metzpatz, which are Hei Hei in the interchange of Atbash, as above; and from them the thirteen attributes of mercy were drawn, namely "El Rahum" etc., and from them they are bestowed. And this is the secret of "YHVH, YHVH, El Rahum..." Understand this.
